sourceNote: A copy of the T-pose mesh rhino-tpose.glb with a quad tube on each arm (assets/models/rhino/README.md). tools/blender/rhino_tpose_arms.py makes it. The faces of the paws, the trunk, the legs, and the head are the faces of the source.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/rhino_tpose_arms.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, so that the curl around the tubes does not fold the faces of the paws.
name: Rhino

app.note: No reference image shows a rhino, so the mesh takes the head top of the parametric rhino, 1.462 m. The skull top between the ears is at 0.9448 u, so the scale is 1.5474 m for each unit, and the standing shoulder joints are at 0.59 u (0.912976 m). The reach is the reach of the arms of the mesh.

armFactorNote: The arms keep the length of the mesh: 0.374 m from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm. The palm reaches the grips of the tuba (pnpm hold-reach rhino --instrument tuba).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. The rhino stands to play the tuba, so no seat asks for longer legs.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The elbow helper is 0.052 units. The app turns the bones from the joints of the pose (poseArm() of src/models/studio-rig.ts).

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within radius (units) of the head of an upper arm take the normals of the skin with no crease angle in the app (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py, studioNormals() of src/models/studio-normals.ts). Thus no dark wedge shows under a raised arm.

jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the top of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The arms are in a T-pose, and the palm faces down. The tail hangs behind the rump.

studio.note: The seated posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 15 degrees out, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). The rhino stands to play the tuba, so no player sits in this pose. The bind forearm turns about the bind upper arm, so that the elbow bends forward and not up.

line.note: The angle 170 of the elephant. On the long thin arm faces of a Meshy mesh, a lower angle mixes the trunk and the paw weights at the middle corners.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the round haunch stays on the hips.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom, each vertex follows the head only. Each ear follows its ear bone above earBase. The tail is a ball on one bone (tailBall).

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh rhino --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

colors.note: The values of samples, palette, dark, and eyeShare are the values of the other meshes. A dark face in the eye box is an eye.

chair.note: The chair of the rig sets the seat top of the seated bind under the haunch. The rhino stands in the app (soloist of ANIMALS), so no player sits on this seat.

sit.note: The values of the hippo and the panda.

armSmooth.note: 6 rounds of taubin() smooth the arm tubes of rhino-tpose-arms.glb after the weights (arm_smooth() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), at most 0.025 units, so that the tubes lose the ridges of the big faces of the T-pose mesh.
